text:
Nina Alvarez: Quick sync — locking internal release note text and timing for v1.13.0 tomorrow. want final copy and embargo window.
Nina Alvarez: Draft: ```Rolling out v1.13.0 tomorrow: optimized batching, lower embedding token cost, and kv-cache eviction fix. Brief inference warmup (~5-10m) expected after canary. No customer data retention changes. Dedicated customers: consider pinning to v1.12.x during your peak windows until you validate on staging.```
Rafael Ortiz: Suggest we call out canary plan inline. otherwise CS will ask.
Priya Singh: Agreed. Add canary cadence + rollback criteria.
Nina Alvarez: Updated draft with canary note: ```... Canary: 10% traffic for 30m, auto-rollforward if 5xx < 0.5% and latency p95 within 200ms of baseline. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 regression >200ms during canary.```
Kai Morgan: Ops: is 0.5% 5xx threshold still OK? some models saw 0.7% transient on last release.
Oncall-Bot: historical 5xx during last release: peak 0.65% at 03:12Z for 6m.
Priya Singh: Let's be conservative — change threshold to 0.4% and require 2 consecutive 5m buckets.
Rafael Ortiz: Fine, but call out that we will auto-rollback only if both conditions persist for 10m. otherwise manual investigation.
Nina Alvarez: New copy: ```Canary: 10% for 30m. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency regression >200ms sustained for 10m. Otherwise will auto-rollforward to 100% over 2h.```
Kai Morgan: Ops approved. I will own watch 21:00-23:30 UTC.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled -> staging: 2025-11-20T17:00Z; prod canary: 2025-11-21T21:00Z -> 10% for 30m -> linear to 100% over 2h.
Priya Singh: Legal asked to include data handling line. add: "no retention changes; no new PII collection".
Nina Alvarez: Inserted. final blurb below for internal RN doc and announce post:
Nina Alvarez: ```Heads up: v1.13.0 deploy tomorrow. Optimized batching, reduced embedding token cost, kv-cache eviction fix. Brief inference warmup (~5-10m). No retention changes; no new PII collection. Canary: 10% for 30m — auto-rollback if 5xx >0.4% or p95 >200ms sustained for 10m. Dedicated customers: pin to v1.12.x during peak windows until validated on staging.```
Rafael Ortiz: Microcopy: change "pin to v1.12.x" -> "pin to v1.12.5 (last-stable)" so CS can give exact command.
Nina Alvarez: Done. Added rollback/pin how-to for CS ops: code block
Nina Alvarez: ```Rollback: deployctl rollback --to v1.12.5 --force
Pin via API: POST /v1/models/pin {"model":"v1.12.5"} with header X-Team-Auth: <token>
Console: Models -> v1.12.5 -> Pin```
Priya Singh: Add short curl example for self-serve customers.
Nina Alvarez: Added: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"v1.12.5"}'`
Kai Morgan: Ops: embargo times? we usually hold internal until 30m after canary start. can we aim to lift embargo at 21:30Z?
Oncall-Bot: Canary start 21:00Z, proposed embargo lift 21:30Z, external release 24h after canary start.
Priya Singh: Sounds good. I'll schedule the internal post for 21:15Z to eng-releases + product + cs with tag @CS-Team.
Rafael Ortiz: CS checklist: include rollback command, pin instructions, and known-risk bullet about kv-cache eviction fix (may cause short mem spikes).
Nina Alvarez: Noted and added to CS notes.
Priya Singh: Approve from Product.
Kai Morgan: Ops approve. Oncall monitoring hooks: error-rate, p50/p95 latency, memory, and kv-cache eviction alerts configured.
DeployBot: Reminder: attach RN draft to internal doc (links: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v1.13.0) and set deploybot embargo flag.
Nina Alvarez: All set. unless objections I'll post at 21:15Z.
Rafael Ortiz: Go ahead. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Go.
Kai Morgan: Standing by oncall.
DeployBot: Canary window locked. Good luck!
